 Two more people died of dengue, taking this year's death toll to 510 and 1,615 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country in the 24 hours until 8am today (19 November). 
 According to the daily update from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), both the deceased were from the Dhaka division.
 A total of 5,617 dengue patients are currently receiving treatment at hospitals.
 Keep updated, follow The Business Standard's Google news channel
 Meanwhile, 1,613 patients were discharged from hospitals during the same 24-hour period, taking the total number of recoveries this year to 162,806.
 The cumulative number of dengue cases reported across the country has now reached 168,933.
